column3: Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-11-dev-invariants-over-deep-readonly.md: 10 heading keys, each an en:/zh: 16-hex hash of that section's text outside code blocks, regenerated by verify-translation-pairing --write.

ADR: Session owns an always-on immutability boundary - one recursive JSON snapshot + deep-freeze on every accepted event; TS DeepReadonly types and a dev-only freezing plugin are both rejected as non-runtime guarantees.

Chinese translation of the immutability ADR (title "源端拥有的会话不可变性"), 28 lines, line-parallel with the English sibling; verified by head read, line-count parity and the sibling pairing record - not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-11-event-sourced-sessions.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the Session is an append-only typed event log and the LLM message history is derived from it (deriveMessages); replay/fork = seeding a new session with an existing log; compaction (not log mutation) is the stated mitigation for derivation cost.
Chinese translation of the event-sourcing ADR (title "事件溯源的会话与派生消息历史"), 16 lines, line-parallel with the English sibling; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-13-capability-seams.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: a swappable capability has three roles - Service Definition (the Cordis service + vocabulary), Service Provider (an implementation), Consumer (what the model programs against); "seam" names the trio, and roles split into separate packages only when they evolve independently.

Chinese translation of the capability-seams ADR (title "能力 seam——Service Definition / Service Provider / Consumer 角色"), 21 lines, keeps the three English role names inside the Chinese text; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-13-twin-llm-adapters.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: ship two real LLM adapters (direct-fetch DeepSeek, SDK-backed pi-ai) against one provider-neutral StreamChunk vocabulary so anything the vocabulary cannot express for BOTH is a core bug; pins usage-before-finish, tool args as raw JSON, and the two sanctioned error paths.
Chinese translation of the twin-adapters ADR (title "以两个 LLM 适配器作为设计验证孪生体"), 16 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-18-session-surface.md: 11 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: a "surface" is a derived, cached ordered projection of event seqs maintained by surfaceOp markers (append / inclusive replace) plus sourceEventSeqs; one delta-based SurfaceManager per Session, O(new events), and it is the foundation compaction rides on.
Chinese translation of the session-surface ADR (title "会话 surface：事件日志上的有序投影"), 38 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-21-bounded-llm-request-recovery.md: 13 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: normalise transient provider failures into one JSON-serialisable LlmFailure (message/code/status/providerRetryAfterMs/requestId, deliberately no retryable flag), retry through the agent/request-error waterfall with a durable llm/retry session event, cap attempts, and let the Web countdown anchor to browser receipt.
Chinese translation of the bounded-recovery ADR (title "LLM 暂时性请求失败的有界恢复"), 91 lines - the largest Chinese note in this shard; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-24-web-capability-seam.md: 24 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: providers register capabilities, never tools; dsh-tool-web owns the model-facing web_search/web_fetch schemas over ctx.web, provider selection happens at execution time, the seam truncates sources itself, and the fetch provider pins the whole DNS answer set to close DNS rebinding.
Chinese translation of the web-seam ADR (title "Web 能力 seam——稳定的工具覆盖多个提供方"), 229 lines - the largest file in this shard by bytes; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-06-30-event-domain-semantics.md: 4 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: three event domains, one job each - session/* is the durable fact log, agent/* the live surface, tools/* the registry; the four agent boundary mirror emits are removed so a boundary has exactly one source of truth.
Chinese translation of the event-domain ADR (title "事件域语义——会话是事实日志，agent 是实时事件通道"), 24 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-02-tool-render-intent-union.md: 11 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: replace the optional-field bag of presentCall/presentResult with a closed, card-tagged union (generic/terminal/diff) where card is a required discriminant and the bridge switch ends in assertNever, so a plugin-added variant is a compile error rather than a silently dropped card.
Chinese translation of the render-intent ADR (title "用于工具调用展示的带标签 render-intent 联合类型"), 52 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-05-prompt-variables-and-tool-guidance-ownership.md: 12 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: every prompt fact has exactly one owner - the loop registers {{provider}}/{{model}} variables, per-tool semantics live in tool descriptions, identity precedes guidance, interpolation is strict (unknown or undefined variables fail before the request) and one renderPrompt path feeds the prompt, the token meter and the recorded header.
Chinese translation of the prompt-ownership ADR (title "提示词变量与工具指导归属"), 42 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-05-reconstructable-requests.md: 8 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: "Model-visible <=> durably referenced" - every request is reconstructable from the log via the public deriveEventMessage fold plus an EpochHeader snapshot; prefix-cache stability is a corollary of append-only projection, and per-call request scalars are forbidden because they silently abandon the cache.
Chinese translation of the reconstructable-requests ADR (title "每个 LLM 请求都可从会话日志重建"), 36 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-06-timeout-deadline-library.md: 8 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: dsh-timeout is a pure-function library (not a Cordis service) owning clamp/deadline/timeoutOf classification while each capability keeps the hard kill; withTimeout is rejected because it resolves the promise without stopping the work, and the division-of-labor table is the note's real payload.
Chinese translation of the timeout-library ADR (title "共享的超时/截止时间原语，硬终止留给各能力自行实现"), 85 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-07-tool-call-timeout-policy.md: 8 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: tool-call timeout is a policy plugin over a new tools/execute around-dispatch waterfall whose base next() IS dispatch-with-normalization (load-bearing), the budget is declared on the ToolDefinition, and the deadline is installed by in-place mutation of exec.signal because a Cordis waterfall's next() ignores arguments.
Chinese translation of the timeout-policy ADR (title "工具调用超时策略作为插件"), 73 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-08-tool-output-spill-files.md: 12 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: a minimal spill seam (saveText -> locator + retrieval hint) plus a policy plugin that replaces oversized final tool results with a preview and a locator; the local backend writes with open(path,'wx',0o600) so a planted symlink cannot redirect it, and spill files are runtime artifacts, not workspace edits.
Chinese translation of the spill-policy ADR (title "工具输出 spill 策略"), 118 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-10-single-file-executable-sdk-runtime-distribution.md: 13 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: ship the Python SDK runtime as a pkg --sea single file with a zero-code deploy-root manifest; a repo patch removes pkg's patchChildProcess (a model-issued "node --version" would otherwise boot the dsh CLI) and makes native-addon extraction atomic, taking concurrent first starts from 39/80 SIGBUS to 0/80.
Chinese translation of the single-exe ADR (title "单文件可执行的 SDK 运行时分发（single-exe）"), 50 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-14-provider-routed-llm-adapters.md: 11 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the provider (not the model id) is the adapter registration key, one provider has exactly one adapter owner per Cordis context, pi-ai gets explicit provider profiles with per-profile credentials and zero SDK retries, and replay state is portable only within the adapter owning both providers.
Chinese translation of the provider-routing ADR (title "基于提供方路由的 LLM 适配器与通用 pi-ai 后端"), 51 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-15-agent-initiator-scope.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: carry the initiating Agent through AsyncLocalStorage as the exact Agent (not a copied frame), with currentInitiator/requireInitiator/withInitiator/withoutInitiator; ambient identity never replaces explicit contracts, and teardown drains active boundaries before AsyncLocalStorage.disable().
Chinese translation of the initiator-scope ADR (title "基于 AsyncLocalStorage 的发起 Agent 作用域"), 33 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-19-cooperative-tool-cancellation.md: 10 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: ToolExecutionInput.signal is a required readonly AbortSignal, mutability follows the pipeline stage (only the tools/execute waterfall gets a mutable dispatch execution), and the registry records ABORTED vs ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH so durable consumers can tell whether side effects were possible.
Chinese translation of the cancellation ADR (title "注册表边界上的协作式工具取消"), 39 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-20-routed-model-context-and-compaction-policy.md: 10 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the adapter owns exact-route context capacity (resolveModel), compaction-basic owns consumer policy keyed by the exact {provider, model} pair with a two-cap trigger floor(min(W*ratio, W-O-headroom)) and 65536-token headroom, and the token meter stays model-agnostic with one fold and no model profiles.
Chinese translation of the compaction-policy ADR (title "路由模型上下文与压缩策略"), 33 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-22-slot-type-chain-implementation.md: 14 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: one ctx.slots.register call simultaneously occupies a slot, declares+authorizes child slots, declares the store and injects the business face; the declaring entry holds exclusive render authority settled at load, and the "chain" kind lets a takeover package register with zero owner edits.
Chinese translation of the slot-system ADR (title "slot 体系标准——单一 register、props 四份额与框架 store 席位"), 81 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-23-client-plugin-loading-model.md: 12 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: split the browser client into a module system that owns module identity and bytes and a vendored Cordis Loader that owns plugin lifecycle; the roster is a yml row set, settlement requires an all-ACTIVE sweep (cordis inject waits have no timeout), and HMR must registry.delete before touching the fiber.
Chinese translation of the client-loader ADR (title "client 插件装载——惰性 factory、Cordis 生命周期与热重载"), 73 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-24-separate-context-injection-from-turn-execution.md: 8 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: inject() is the only caller-facing context operation and a turn means one model-loop execution; injected context is an identified frozen UserMessage delivered at the nearest later pre-step boundary, and idle injection no longer opens a zero-step injection turn.
Chinese translation of the context-injection ADR (title "将上下文注入与轮次执行分离"), 42 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-24-single-harness-home-resolver.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: one resolver owns the harness home (configured > $DSH_HOME > ~/.dsh, empty/whitespace = unset) with a symbolic display name so no absolute machine path leaks into a user-facing label; the two drifted copies of resolveDshHome are deleted and XDG is rejected.
Chinese translation of the home-resolver ADR (title "单一 harness home 解析器"), 22 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-27-compiler-independent-typert-model.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: extract a compiler-independent WorkspaceModel/FaceModel/TypeGraph from separate Host and Client ts.Programs; the model keeps pre-evaluation type structure, a type it cannot represent losslessly fails analysis instead of degrading to unknown, and the registry validates schema factories without invoking them.
Chinese translation of the typert-model ADR (title "编译器无关的 Typert 类型模型"), 28 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-28-api-browser-trust-boundary.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: enforce browser trust once at the carrier for the whole /api prefix - a media-type fence (POST must be application/json) plus an authority fence (Host must be loopback or trusted, Origin must equal Host, cross-site is refused) - with deliberately no shortcut for unmarked reads, because Host is the one header DNS rebinding cannot forge.
Chinese translation of the browser-trust ADR (title "所有 /api 路由共用一道载体级浏览器信任边界"), 20 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-28-identified-immutable-message-values.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: one Message value with a required id minted at creation (createMessage detaches and deep-freezes); creation helpers exclude an input id, freezeMessage is the separate import boundary, and a representation change preserves the id while a new semantic message mints one.
Chinese translation of the identified-message ADR (title "将每条消息创建为带标识的不可变值"), 26 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-28-portable-execution-world-consumers.md: 7 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: ctx.fs plus ctx.subprocess define one execution world that PTY and LSP consume, so a remote provider needs no duplicate consumer packages; spawnTerminal is one deep primitive whose handle owns I/O, foreground groups and a TERM-to-KILL quiescence operation over its provider-owned range.
Chinese translation of the execution-world ADR (title "基于文件系统与进程管理执行世界的可移植消费方"), 37 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-29-dsh-source-launch-tsx-esm.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: Node 26 removed --experimental-transform-types, so the CLI source launches via node --import tsx/esm; tsx owns transformation and paths mapping, and the loss of runtime declared-dependency enforcement is stated plainly and left to the static gates.
Chinese translation of the source-launch ADR (title "dsh 通过 tsx ESM 钩子源码启动"), 22 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-29-projected-token-usage-and-request-context.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: durable token billing and context occupancy are ordinary session-projection units (tokenUsage folds the whole log, contextPressure carries pressureTokens/contextWindow, request/context records the route); the note records implementing an atomic live frame and rejecting it because Host and mux are independent SSE streams with no cross-stream ordering.
Chinese translation of the token-usage ADR (title "token 用量投影与上下文占用率"), 31 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-29-terminal-llm-stream-failures.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: LlmRuntime is the single normalisation boundary for one adapter attempt - it converts a thrown value to an immutable LlmFailure and emits one terminal finish, the adapter catch ends before each yielded chunk so middleware/assembly bugs stay thrown, and the stream-keyed sidecar APIs are deleted.
Chinese translation of the terminal-failure ADR (title "LLM 流的终止失败"), 19 lines; read in part (head 12 lines) to confirm the translation format; not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-30-credential-boundaries-and-atomic-registration.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the credential document belongs to the credential provider alone (no surface hoists it into process.env), one request resolves one frozen configuration snapshot, route replacement hangs on the registration handle so ownership is structural, and the note withdraws its own sandbox read-denial after measuring that bwrap cannot confine wherever no credential exists.
Chinese translation of the credential-boundary ADR (title "凭据边界、按整份快照发起的请求与原子路由注册"), 20 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-30-followup-enqueue-and-owned-runs.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: Agent.followup is enqueue-only and no result is causally attributed to a message; the low-level SDK answers session/prompt with {messageId} and has no session.finished, and only an explicitly owned activity interval (receipt to next whole-agent idle) may report a RunResult.
Chinese translation of the owned-runs ADR (title "follow-up 入队与自有运行边界"), 23 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-31-goal-owned-durable-events.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the goal domain owns a durable goal/change session event carrying the whole post-mutation snapshot, so goal state is independent of inbox placement and admission; activation stays process-local and a goal mutation does not automatically become model input.
Chinese translation of the goal-events ADR (title "Goal 自有的持久事件"), 18 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-07-31-ptc-runtime-python-fd3-protocol.md: 7 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the fd-3 PTC frame protocol treats the child channel as hostile - validateChildFrame rebuilds every inbound frame field by field, and the lossless-JSON codec traverses iteratively with a non-allocating escaped-size scan so a deep value crosses intact.

Chinese translation of the fd-3 protocol ADR, whose H1 is left in English ("the ptc-runtime-python fd-3 frame protocol") while the body is translated; 24 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-02-typert-remote-method-calls.md: 24 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: a business Service declares remotely callable methods with @Remote/@RemoteScope and Typert generates a platform-independent consumer projection (d.ts + .d.ts.map + .js) that imports canonical business type symbols rather than copying DTOs; the Gateway owns one /api route and Remote never exposes fetch or a request handle.
Chinese translation of the Typert Remote ADR (title "Typert Gateway 定向方法调用"), 359 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-04-configuration-source-ownership.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: one six-tier ordering for non-secret values (explicit run > user settings > composition > launch shell > discovered file > defaults) and a narrower credential ordering; a discovered .env is refused if it sets anything governing launch, ambient programs, pre-program code execution, instruction loading or network routing - organised by behaviour, not by variable name.
Chinese translation of the configuration-ownership ADR (title "配置来源的统一顺序，以及被发现的文件不得决定什么"), 46 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-05-profile-plugin-bundles.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: profiles replace hardcoded launcher compositions - a profile is a directory with an explicit ordered dsh.profile.bundles list and patches applied over an empty root, resolved two-anchored (installation first, then the profile directory) so bundles stay installation-owned without link: entries.
Chinese translation of the profile-bundles ADR (title "profile 插件组合包取代固定的表层 overlay"), 22 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-09-client-conversation-node-assembly.md: 30 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: a target-neutral business-node assembly engine - each Definition's match(event) sees only the current event, a (kind,id) Context collects ordered Matches, Location is an engine fact, and publication cadence (immediate/animation-frame/none) is separated from the state update so streaming deltas never remount rows.
Chinese translation of the node-assembly ADR (title "Client Conversation 业务节点组装与 Chat keyed snapshot"), 261 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-10-cancelled-stream-prefix-finalize.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: a cancelled stream finalises the prefix the user already saw as an assistant/message with interrupted:true appended before the committed end frame, so a follow-up or a fork no longer lacks text the user read; tool calls and empty blocks are excluded.
Chinese translation of the cancelled-prefix ADR (title "被取消的流定稿其已送达前缀"), 20 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-10-fork-children-stay-one-shot.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: a continuable fork child may keep the parent's request prefix because send_message is registered globally with the same schema and ordering, and the return guidance rides the child's initial task after the inherited seed; the note states it tests equality of assembled request-head inputs, not a provider's cache behaviour.
Chinese translation of the fork-prefix ADR (title "Fork child 保留 parent 请求前缀"), 24 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-10-host-plane-ownership-after-presets.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the token meter is host-plane because sessionProjections is a process-wide table with no scope layering - a unit whose empty value is indistinguishable from a real one cannot be per-composition; entry points must join Agents explicitly, and no runtime check rejects an unjoined Agent.

Chinese translation of the host-plane ADR, whose H1 is left in English ("What stays host-plane once presets own the agent plane") while the body is translated; 22 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-10-session-log-version-mechanism.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: one monotonic session-format integer with direction-aware refusal (equal reads, newer refuses and names the direction, older runs the adjacent chain in memory leaving the source bytes untouched) and a per-event ignorable marker that defaults to REQUIRED, because a default of ignorable would silently resume a gutted session.
Chinese translation of the log-versioning ADR (title "Session log 版本机制：单调整数、升级器链、逐事件可忽略标记"), 24 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-13-credential-records-and-authorization-flows.md: 7 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: extend the credential plane from env-name references to records and flows - the CredentialKey is scoped by the OWNING PLUGIN's registered name, records never layer, and a separate authorization seam owns the conversation while the flow owns the write, with withFileLock's 2 s default explained by pi-ai refreshing OAuth inside credentials.modify().
Chinese translation of the credential-records ADR (title "凭据记录与授权 flow"), 37 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-15-client-shells-and-dynamic-packages.md: 9 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: five client layers with explicit build forms (web compilation shell, framework-free startup kernel, static assembly libraries, module bootstrap, dynamic packages); each build face decides externality independently of npm sections, and a shared module request has exactly two suppliers.
Chinese translation of the client-shells ADR (title "客户端壳分层与动态包边界"), 51 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-18-session-history-and-event-transport.md: 18 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: three recovery semantics (durable paginated logs, process-local snapshots, fire-and-forget notifications) over one transport lifecycle; a journal stream establishes its opening cursor before the initial page so the history/subscribe race closes, and observation must never resume an Agent.
Chinese translation of the transport ADR (title "会话历史、控制状态与 Remote 事件传输"), 217 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-19-session-projection-mandatory-seam.md: 5 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: the projection registry and its key are a required reader seam - a plugin either declares sessionProjections as a required injection or throws on the first dependent access, and optional ctx.inject registration controls the child lifecycle only, never authorises a default value.
Chinese translation of the projection-seam ADR (title "会话投影作为必需的读取 seam"), 21 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-20-client-session-conversation-ownership.md: 49 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: one-way client layering (controller/domain object -> ui-* adapter -> ui-renderer -> Slot component) with no aggregate runtime package; pending interactions live in a business UI source rather than a Session projection, and the Sidebar and composer read one effective sessionStatus so they cannot select different requests.
Chinese translation of the client-ownership ADR (title "Client Session、Conversation 与 UI 所有权分层"), 288 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-21-deepseek-llm-api-request-extensions.md: 11 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: two extra top-level request fields (dsh_session_log, dsh_plugin_packages) live on the official DeepSeek adapter only, delivered at-least-once via a durable delivery-accepted watermark; the note measures and rejects request-relative message references (701 of 115,071 events, 0.54 % byte saving) instead of versioning the wire format.
Chinese translation of the request-extensions ADR (title "DeepSeek LLM API 会话日志与插件包请求扩展"), 50 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-22-single-dsh-application-launcher.md: 12 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: every supported Node application starts through the dsh CLI and one named profile; no shipped profile enables server module HMR (the row ships disabled so every new app does not have to remember to opt out), and the protocol profiles reserve stdout for protocol frames.
Chinese translation of the launcher ADR (title "由一个 dsh 启动应用 profile"), 59 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.

Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-23-client-derived-tool-presentation.md: 75 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes - the largest pairing record in this shard; read in full to confirm the format.

ADR: the Session Remote journal carries only raw validated events - no tool-argument parsing, Tools-registry lookup, presenter scope or view clone - while the Client derives its cards from raw arguments plus durable presentationMeta, degrading to Generic on any malformed input.
Chinese translation of the tool-presentation ADR (title "Client 从原始 Session 工具事件派生展示"), 481 lines; verified by head read + parity, not read line by line.
Bilingual-pair consistency record for 2026-08-23-locale-owned-client-ui-copy.md: 6 heading keys with en:/zh: hashes.

ADR: locale dictionaries own all product-authored client UI wording, enforced by a TypeScript-AST gate that refuses a narrowed corpus; localized display text is never an identity (models keep discriminants and stable ids, renderers translate after matching), and primitives take required localized props rather than owning a fallback language.
